page.layout: One printed page, a tree diagram with braces and brackets, no running text. The root box sits at the left, its brace opening to two boxes at level 2 ("Annatum. Isque" above, "Separatum" below). Level 3 has Tactus, Gustus, Olfactus, Auditus and Visus, each with its objectum, organon and medium boxes at level 4 on the right, and the examples beside each brace at the far right. No running head, no page number and no catchword are printed.

main_text.l: N. Sensus externus Medium suū aut Sensorio habet
Separatum: Quod est communiter Aer & Aqua. us[?]

page.notes: Diagram transcribed as an outline, one line per box, depth read from the braces. The examples at the right are kept with their boxes; those for Tactus and Gustus are set as separate lines beside their groups. Faint show-through of the page behind is not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "Annatum" (possibly a misreading of "Animatum"), the word after "Aqua." and "Humiufq;" (perhaps "Humidusq;") are marked [?]. The printed "ut" in the Separatum box may read differently.
